DE.name: Germany
DE.notes: Full EU Single Market CE Declaration. WEEE registration required for B2C/B2B.

FR.name: France
FR.notes: Triman sorting signage mandatory on packaging.

IT.name: Italy
IT.notes: Mandatory environmental labeling on all packaging materials.

ES.name: Spain
ES.notes: Royal Decree on packaging waste declarations applies.

NL.name: Netherlands
NL.notes: Major European entry port for customs clearance with CE DoC.

SE.name: Sweden
SE.notes: Swedish chemical tax on flame retardants in electronics may apply.

AT.name: Austria
AT.notes: Authorized representative required for packaging waste.

DK.name: Denmark
DK.notes: Safety Board active market surveillance on power adapters.

GB.name: United Kingdom
GB.notes: UKCA mark required. UK PSTI compliance statement mandatory for connectable devices.

CH.name: Switzerland
CH.notes: Accepts CE mark directly under mutual recognition for ITE.

NO.name: Norway
NO.notes: EEA member; full CE mark equivalence.

IS.name: Iceland
IS.notes: EEA member; full CE mark equivalence.

LI.name: Liechtenstein
LI.notes: EEA member; full CE mark equivalence.

RU.name: Russia
RU.notes: EAC certificate / declaration required. In-country accredited testing or recognized CB.

BY.name: Belarus
BY.notes: EAEU rules plus national energy efficiency marking TR 2018/024/BY.

KZ.name: Kazakhstan
KZ.notes: EAC declaration recognized across all EAEU member states.

UA.name: Ukraine
UA.notes: National Technical Regulation conformity mark (trefoil in circle) required.

RS.name: Serbia
RS.notes: Kvalitet AAA mark required for designated electronic equipment.

TR.name: Turkey
TR.notes: EU-Turkey Customs Union allows direct CE marking acceptance.

GE.name: Georgia
GE.notes: Recognizes CE / CB test reports directly.

AZ.name: Azerbaijan
AZ.notes: National AZS certificate required for mains power devices.

UZ.name: Uzbekistan
UZ.notes: In-country testing or bilateral CB report recognition.

US.name: United States
US.notes: FCC SDoC for un-intentional radiators. NRTL (UL/CSA/ETL) safety mark expected for powered units. DoE Level VI mandatory for external power supply.

CA.name: Canada
CA.notes: ICES-003 Class B compliance statement on packaging/label. NRCan energy efficiency for power adapters.

MX.name: Mexico
MX.notes: Mandatory in-country safety testing for power adapters. Local Mexican importer holds certificate.

BR.name: Brazil
BR.notes: INMETRO safety certification mandatory for AC power adapters. Local factory audit / annual maintenance required.

AR.name: Argentina
AR.notes: Mandatory S-Mark safety certification for external power adapters. In-country testing / CB deviation evaluation.

CL.name: Chile
CL.notes: SEC QR code label mandatory on certified products and power adapters.

CO.name: Colombia
CO.notes: RETIE certificate of conformity required for external power adapters. CB report accepted with local review.

PE.name: Peru
PE.notes: MTC approval required for telecom/RF. Passive ITE storage requires standard customs DoC.

EC.name: Ecuador
EC.notes: INEN certificate required for external power adapters based on CB report.

UY.name: Uruguay
UY.notes: Accepts CB test certificate and FCC/CE reports.

BO.name: Bolivia
BO.notes: Type approval with FCC/CE test reports.

CR.name: Costa Rica
CR.notes: SUTEL homologation with FCC test reports.

DO.name: Dominican Republic
DO.notes: FCC test report accepted for homologation.

PR.name: Puerto Rico
PR.notes: US Federal jurisdiction; standard FCC and NRTL safety apply.

CN.name: China
CN.notes: Mandatory CCC for external power supplies & designated ITE. In-country testing at CNAS lab required. China RoHS mark and hazardous table mandatory.

JP.name: Japan
JP.notes: VCCI Class B voluntary registration for ITE. PSE Diamond mandatory for external AC adapters (METI registered conformity body).

KR.name: South Korea
KR.notes: KC Mark mandatory for EMC and Safety. Local Korean testing at designated lab required for high-risk power adapters.

TW.name: Taiwan
TW.notes: BSMI registration of product certification (RPC) mandatory for SSDs and power adapters. Section 5 restricted substance declaration required on packaging.

HK.name: Hong Kong
HK.notes: EMSD Electrical Products Safety Regulation recognizes CB Certificate and CE DoC.

MN.name: Mongolia
MN.notes: Conformity certificate based on CB test reports.

IN.name: India
IN.notes: Mandatory BIS CRS registration for External SSDs and AC power adapters. Local testing at BIS accredited laboratory in India. Authorized Indian Representative (AIR) required.

PK.name: Pakistan
PK.notes: CB test report accepted by PSQCA.

BD.name: Bangladesh
BD.notes: BSTI clearance required based on CB test reports.

LK.name: Sri Lanka
LK.notes: Import inspection scheme accepts CB Scheme test certificates.

SG.name: Singapore
SG.notes: Mains-connected external power adapters require mandatory SAFETY Mark registration based on CB Certificate. Importer must register with CPSO.

MY.name: Malaysia
MY.notes: SIRIM Certificate of Conformity required for external power adapters. Batch testing / consignment inspection or PC-based approval.

ID.name: Indonesia
ID.notes: SNI certification required for AC power cords/adapters. Local representative and factory audit may apply.

TH.name: Thailand
TH.notes: TIS 62368-1 mandatory for power adapters and specific ITE audio/video. In-country testing and factory inspection required.

VN.name: Vietnam
VN.notes: Local testing at designated Vietnamese lab required for QCVN safety and EMC.

PH.name: Philippines
PH.notes: Import Commodity Clearance (ICC) or PS license required for external power supplies based on CB test report.

MM.name: Myanmar
MM.notes: Type approval based on FCC/CE test reports.

BN.name: Brunei
BN.notes: Type approval based on CE/CB reports.

AU.name: Australia
AU.notes: RCM mark mandatory. External power adapters are Level 3 in-scope electrical equipment requiring Certificate of Conformity and registration on National EESS Database.

NZ.name: New Zealand
NZ.notes: Trans-Tasman Mutual Recognition Agreement harmonizes with Australia RCM.

SA.name: Saudi Arabia
SA.env_std: SASO RoHS 2026 / Technical Regulation for Restriction of Hazardous Substances
SA.notes: Mandatory registration on SABER platform. Product Certificate of Conformity (PCoC) and Shipment Certificate (SCoC) required. SASO RoHS declaration mandatory.

AE.name: United Arab Emirates
AE.notes: ECAS (Emirates Conformity Assessment Scheme) mandatory for IT equipment and power adapters. UAE RoHS certificate required.

KW.name: Kuwait
KW.notes: Kuwait Conformity Assurance Scheme (KUCAS) Technical Evaluation Report (TER) based on CB report.

QA.name: Qatar
QA.notes: Certificate of Conformity required for customs clearance based on CB Scheme.

BH.name: Bahrain
BH.notes: Accepts GCC harmonized standards and international CB reports.

OM.name: Oman
OM.notes: CB Scheme and Gulf conformity mark accepted.

IL.name: Israel
IL.notes: Standards Institution of Israel (SII) import permit based on CB report + national deviations test.

EG.name: Egypt
EG.notes: GOEIC factory inspection and pre-shipment inspection certificate required.

MA.name: Morocco
MA.notes: CMIM conformity marking mandatory on products and packaging. Accepts CE/CB reports for DoC.

JO.name: Jordan
JO.notes: Pre-shipment verification of conformity based on CB report.

TN.name: Tunisia
TN.notes: Type approval with CE/CB test reports.

DZ.name: Algeria
DZ.notes: Commercial quality control and conformity certificate.

YE.name: Yemen
YE.notes: Pre-shipment inspection based on CB report.

ZA.name: South Africa

NG.name: Nigeria
NG.notes: Standards Organisation of Nigeria Conformity Assessment Program (SONCAP) mandatory for all regulated imports.

KE.name: Kenya
